title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - PowerPlan
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/PowerPlan. The Power Plan that an energy manager creates for a device. It contains three timeseries indicating the minimum, average, and maximum respectively. Subclass of TimeSeries per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the TimeSeries model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerPlan'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isWritable.description: Property. This Boolean value indicates whether this power plan is writable or fixed.
